_meta.method: Playwright browser_evaluate computed-style extraction (not visual estimation)
_meta.note: Nearly monochrome (black/white/gray) with ONE deliberate accent: a small lime-green #B3FF00 status dot (6x6px) on the 'Available for Projects' nav badge -- found via a full-page color sweep. rgb(0,0,238) appearing on some <a> tags is the unstyled browser default link color inherited by wrapper anchors with no visible text of their own -- not a design color.
_meta.correctionNote:
The first crawl pass got the hero/intro background WRONG (marked dark, actually light) and missed that the nav is a permanent solid light bar and that primary buttons are dark pills by default. Root cause: this template renders duplicate overlapping elements at identical coordinates for several key nodes (e.g. two

NEXOLA

at the exact same rect, one rgb(246,246,246) one rgb(15,15,15)) -- plain `document.querySelector()` + getComputedStyle silently grabbed the occluded/wrong one. Re-verified every section using document.elementFromPoint() at the actual painted pixel (after scrollIntoView) instead of trusting the first DOM match. See colors.note and components.nav/heroSection below for the corrected values.

colors.accent: rgb(179, 255, 0) / #B3FF00 -- used ONLY for the 6x6px 'available' status dot, nowhere else
colors.note: CORRECTED section-by-section background map, verified via elementFromPoint (not inferred from text color): Hero = LIGHT. Introduction (CEO quote/stats) = LIGHT. Projects = LIGHT. Case Study = DARK. Skillset = LIGHT. Team = LIGHT. Pricing = DARK (cards flush dark, except the featured 'Growth' card's CTA which inverts to a light pill). Testimonials/'Why choose us'/brand strip = DARK (testimonial cards themselves are white/#FFF cards popping against the dark section, not flush). FAQ = LIGHT (the whole section, not just the accordion list). Contact = DARK. Footer = LIGHT. So the page is mostly light with two dark bands (Case Study, and Pricing-through-Contact) rather than 'dark by default with light islands' as first assumed.

sectionHeadingLarge.usage: H2 section titles: Projects, Case Study, Contact

sectionHeadingMedium.usage: H2/H5 section titles: Skillset, Pricing, Team heading

labelSmall.usage: Stat labels ('established since'), nav badge ('Available for Projects')

typography.lineHeightRatio: ~1.0-1.08 for display/heading sizes (tight), ~1.2 for body/label sizes

pageGutter.note: horizontal padding at viewport edges, measured at 1440 and 390

spacing.contentMaxWidth: ~1365px effective content width inside gutters at 1440 viewport (container itself ~1425-1440px)

twoColumnGrid.usage: Skillset services grid, Pricing header (intro cell + 3 pricing-tier cells in a 2x2 grid)

spacing.footerPadding: 100px 0px 0px (top only; inner columns handle their own horizontal padding)

scrollReveal.trigger: IntersectionObserver-driven appear animation (Framer's built-in scroll-triggered reveal), not hover
scrollReveal.usage: Applied per-section/element as content scrolls into view: fades in while translating up 200px to 0.

hoverInteractions.note: Buttons/links show transition-duration: 0s and transition-property: all in their resting computed style -- hover/tap feedback is driven by JS (Framer Motion whileHover/whileTap), not a static CSS transition. Treat button hover states as a short (~150-250ms) opacity/scale response rather than a measured CSS value.

nav.background: CORRECTED: permanently solid bgLight (rgb(246,246,246)), fixed position (position:fixed on an ancestor wrapper, z-index:10) -- does NOT change on scroll. The `nav` tag itself computes transparent; the real opaque background lives on an inner wrapper div, which is why a shallow querySelector check missed it.
nav.textColor: always bgDark/#0F0F0F, regardless of what section scrolls beneath
nav.mobileBehavior: stacks to flex-direction: column at <=809px viewport; no distinct hamburger-button element detected in DOM inspection

heroSection.background:
CORRECTED: bgLight, not bgDark. Verified via elementFromPoint after discovering two overlapping

NEXOLA

nodes at the same rect (one per color) -- querySelector('h1') grabbed the wrong (occluded) one originally.
heroSection.textColor: bgDark (#0F0F0F) headline text on the light section
heroSection.statLabels: 14px/600 weight muted gray, e.g. '2022 established since', '120+ brands launched'
heroSection.ctaButtons: pill buttons, 20px 40px padding, 100px radius. CORRECTED: default/primary CTA is a DARK pill (bg #0F0F0F, text #F6F6F6) -- confirmed on hero 'Start Your Project', footer newsletter button, and non-featured pricing CTAs. Only the featured pricing card's CTA inverts to a light pill (bg #F6F6F6, text #0F0F0F) for emphasis against its dark card.

projectCards.layout: stacked full-width rows (NOT a 3-column grid) -- each card ~1365px wide x 372px tall, 20px vertical gap between rows

pricingSection.layout: 2x2 grid: cell(0,0) = intro/toggle content (682x400), remaining 3 cells = Starter/Growth/Performance cards (682x400 each), 0px gap between cells
pricingSection.cardBackground: rgb(15,15,15) -- flush with dark section bg, no visible border/shadow separating cards

faqAccordion.panelBackground: CORRECTED: the entire FAQ section is bgLight, not just an inset list panel on a dark section -- verified via elementFromPoint at the section's outer heading.

footer.newsletterButton: pill, 20px 40px padding, 100px radius, dark bg (#0F0F0F) with light text -- inverse of primary button
